FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: AI Detects Support near MA20 with Oversold RSI as Fed Focus on Inflation
tldr_points: USD/JPY trades below MA20 with RSI ~32, indicating oversold conditions.
Fed’s inflation focus and record Eurozone equities suggest a risk‑on bias that could weaken the yen.
Technical bias favors a bounce toward the MA20 resistance around 161.12.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY below MA20, RSI ~32, bounce potential as Fed flags inflation; EU equities at records and USD strength modest.
FX.comment: Oversold RSI and bullish fundamentals favor a bounce to MA20 resistance.
